import ast
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

root = Path('/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/LogAnalysisSkill')
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools'))
from terminal_scan import fixed_inputs, write_atomic, HEAD, TREE, RULES_SHA, ModuleIndex, contexts
from terminal_callable_ids import callable_ids, assert_unique, name_forms
out = root/'docs/clang-fix-campaign/dev_memory/stage14_p49_terminal_batch/a0-evidence/part3/erratum10'
manifest, files = fixed_inputs(Path.cwd(),root)
index=ModuleIndex(files,contexts(files))
old=json.loads((out/'callable-id-scan.json').read_text())
old_lambdas={r['candidate_id'] for r in old['callables'] if r['anonymous']}
rows=[]; issues=[]; line_proxies=defaultdict(list); same_line_assignment_groups=[]; cross_statement_import_groups=[]
for entry in manifest['entries']:
    if entry['entry_kind']!='PY_SOURCE':continue
    path=entry['path']; source=files[path].decode(); tree=ast.parse(source)
    first=callable_ids(source,path,sys.argv)
    second=callable_ids(source,path,sys.argv)
    assert first==second
    issues.extend(first['issues'])
    identities=index.by_path.get(path,[])
    assert len(identities)<=1
    module=identities[0][1] if identities else None
    for r in first['callables']:
        r['context']=entry['context']; r['name_forms']=name_forms(r,module)
        r.pop('source')
        rows.append(r)
        line_proxies[(path,r['span'][0],r['span'][2])].append(r['candidate_id'])
    # Sweep the other same-line binding spellings too; do not stop at the first import.
    parents={c:p for p in ast.walk(tree) for c in ast.iter_child_nodes(p)}
    assigns=defaultdict(list); imports=defaultdict(list)
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node,(ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom)):
            imports[(node.lineno,node.end_lineno)].append(ast.get_source_segment(source,node))
        if isinstance(node,ast.Assign) and isinstance(node.value,(ast.Name,ast.Attribute)):
            scope=parents[node]
            while not isinstance(scope,(ast.Module,ast.ClassDef,ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef,ast.Lambda)):
                scope=parents[scope]
            names=[t.id for t in node.targets if isinstance(t,ast.Name)]
            if isinstance(scope,ast.Module) and names:
                assigns[(node.lineno,node.end_lineno)].extend(names)
    for span,v in imports.items():
        if len(v)>1:cross_statement_import_groups.append({'path':path,'lines':span,'sources':v})
    for span,v in assigns.items():
        if len(v)>1:same_line_assignment_groups.append({'path':path,'lines':span,'names':v})
lambdas=[r for r in rows if r['anonymous']]
assert_unique(lambdas)
assert {r['candidate_id'] for r in lambdas}==old_lambdas
proxy_groups=[{'location':key,'ids':values} for key,values in line_proxies.items() if len(values)>1]
raw=json.loads((out/'span-feasibility-probe.json').read_text())['groups']
explicit=[g for g in raw if g['explicit_pair']]
minimal=[g for g in explicit if g['path']=='tizen-ci-triage/scripts/ci_triage/report.py']
assert len(minimal)==2
witness=[]
for g in minimal:
    spans=[]
    for item in g['items']:
        spans.append({'candidate_id':g['path']+'#REEXPORT#'+item['name'],
                      'contract_span':[g['path'],g['lines'][0],g['lines'][1],g['kind'],'TRUE'],
                      'ast_columns_not_in_contract':item['span'][1::2]})
    assert len({r['candidate_id'] for r in spans})==3
    assert len({tuple(r['contract_span']) for r in spans})==1
    witness.append({'source':g['source'],'rows':spans})
result={'head':HEAD,'tree':TREE,'rules_sha256':RULES_SHA,'python_entries':272,
        'scope':'E10 IDs and all-tree same-line span feasibility, NOT full candidate inventory',
        'repeat_equal':True,'identity_location_issues':issues,'anonymous_collisions':0,
        'anonymous_rows':lambdas,'raw_multi_binding_groups':raw,
        'explicit_reexport_groups':explicit,'cross_statement_import_groups':cross_statement_import_groups,
        'same_line_assignment_groups':same_line_assignment_groups,'same_line_callable_groups':proxy_groups,
        'minimal_witness':witness,'stopping_issue':'SCAN-09'}
write_atomic(out/'candidate-span-stop.json',result)
print('E10: five collision groups resolved; 121 lambda IDs unique; two full scans identical')
print('all_callable_sites='+str(len(rows))+' code_location_issues='+str(len(issues)))
print('python_entries=272 context_counts='+str(dict(Counter(e['context'] for e in manifest['entries']))))
print('raw_same_line_multi_binding_groups='+str(len(raw))+' explicit_reexport_groups='+str(len(explicit)))
print('by_kind='+str(dict(Counter(g['kind'] for g in raw))))
print('explicit_by_context='+str(dict(Counter(g['context'] for g in explicit))))
print('cross_statement_import_groups='+str(len(cross_statement_import_groups)))
print('same_line_assignment_groups='+str(len(same_line_assignment_groups)))
print('same_line_callable_groups='+str(len(proxy_groups)))
for g in explicit: print(g['path']+':'+str(g['lines'])+' '+g['kind']+' '+','.join(i['name'] for i in g['items']))
print(json.dumps(witness,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print('SEAL-7 RED: distinct candidate IDs share the frozen five-field span; N1 cannot merge distinct binding names')
